features.title: Restore QR labels and manual delivery status controls
features.user_visible_behavior: Orders show their current status and QR labels; authorized operations staff can select warehouse, on the way, delivered, or another configured status. Unrelated order edits preserve the current status.
verification_steps: Verify status badge contrast with missing, blank, supported, and unsupported color values; display Unknown status for blank labels without changing stored status data.

Verify scanner dialog has a visible input, manual submit, error feedback, and Close/Escape support without animation or repeated focus capture; confirm an existing order code opens its preview and dismisses the scanner.
Verify rendered QR labels for multiple bags and missing legacy bag counts.
Verify manual status changes, invalid inputs, role and pharmacy restrictions, delivery completion and reopening.
Verify omitted status and bag fields do not erase existing values.
Run installed tests and smoke checks, asset build, and available PHP formatter.

features.title: Show or hide passwords on login and registration
features.user_visible_behavior: Login, registration password, and registration confirmation fields start masked and provide independent keyboard-accessible eye buttons to reveal or hide the entered text without submitting or changing it.
verification_steps: Run the existing baseline and authentication tests.
Check show/hide behavior, independent fields, retained values, keyboard access, and registration validation in a browser.
Review the final diff and update session evidence.
